spec2def(dxgthk.sys dxgthk.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# dxgthk.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxgthk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(dxgthk_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(dxgthk_shims PRIVATE libwin32k)
add_cargo_module(dxgthk dxgthk-cargo dxgthk.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxgthk_shims psdk)
